supersedes_only_interpretation: Prior SOURCE_TARGET_IDENTIFIABILITY_REVIEW.json wording about physical/native meanings must not be read as requiring actual mesh-vertex/surface membership. Prior review remains byte unchanged; its instance/reference-selector and leakage concerns remain conditional.

authoritative_scope.meaning: native8 cuboid points are virtual bbox/cuboid extrema; stored dynamic order and perm_v4 mapping must be handled once. Rays to those points do not prove physical surface presence.
M0 target-only silhouette, M4 final visible silhouette, and convex-cuboid self front-facing rule are distinct representations; no semantic equivalence is inferred automatically.

Lack of mesh-corner support or PnP success must not block crop/presence learning. Semantic visibility and query-pixel presence differ; current human semantic annotations exist and are not pixel segmentation GT.
v60 is a virtual-point external-ray blockage proxy, not physical DIRECT visibility and not M4 query-pixel presence.

The four registered local meshes retained their native cuboid extrema without snapping. Exact physical surface support was0/32 under a fixed tolerance. That invalidates treating those fixture points as physical mesh points, not using the original virtual references or learning target support around q; no universal40K asset proof is implied.

native_reference_definition.native_index_mapping: A reference/cuboid semantic convention: slot order, cuboid orientation, native-to-dynamic permutation, target-instance association and the operative annotation convention.
does_not_require: a physical board tip at the projected coordinate
snapping a virtual native point to a physical feature
preserve: original initializer q and native ordering
all existing q/L/crop/box values in frozen evaluations
virtual cuboid reference when that is the actual native definition
UNKNOWN mapping when correspondence convention is unverified
native_reference_definition.physical_generic_cue: May be explicit auxiliary/source conditional supervision; it is not a replacement native8 definition and need not be mapped onto an exact native mesh vertex.

separate_prediction_targets.name: QUERY_PIXEL_OR_CROP_TARGET_SUPPORT
separate_prediction_targets.question: At the initial q or within its specified crop, is there observable support/appearance of the intended target pallet?
separate_prediction_targets.permitted_supervision: Exact pixel M4/visible-instance membership or a separately declared crop-support label, from synthetic and approved public real data with known provenance.
separate_prediction_targets.limits: Specify exact pixel versus neighborhood/crop target; do not silently change the decision radius. This score alone does not establish semantic external/self cause or visibility of a specific cuboid reference.

separate_prediction_targets.name: NATIVE_VIRTUAL_CUBOID_REFERENCE_SEMANTIC_VISIBILITY
separate_prediction_targets.question: Under the declared native cuboid reference and annotation convention, is that intended reference visible, externally covered, self-hidden, out of crop/frame or unknown?
separate_prediction_targets.permitted_supervision: Labels with established cuboid/native association and an explicit visibility convention, including conditional source annotations/interventions. Physical surface membership is not a necessary condition.
separate_prediction_targets.limits: A virtual-ray obstruction proxy or visible-mask pixel event may be useful evidence but is not silently renamed semantic D/E/S. Current human labels can evaluate semantic/crop-level transfer without being exact-pixel occupancy truth.

separate_prediction_targets.name: GENERIC_PHYSICAL_AI_CUE_VISIBILITY_AUXILIARY
separate_prediction_targets.question: Is the particular frozen RGB-observed rim/edge/corner cue visible under a controlled intervention?
separate_prediction_targets.permitted_supervision: V71/V72 conditional RGB cue/range and same-cue controlled cover, with FULL/MISS/U and source provenance preserved.
separate_prediction_targets.limits: This is an auxiliary/conditional task. It does not redefine the native virtual cuboid points or prove native8 transfer.

explicit_non_implications: Virtual native point lacks exact mesh support -> does NOT block query/crop presence training.
M0=0 or M4=0 at a native projection -> does NOT alone imply semantic S or E.
M4>0 at q -> does NOT alone imply the intended semantic cuboid reference is D.
Human reference D with q background -> can be a coordinate/crop-target difference, not necessarily a bad human semantic label.
A physically visible edge near a virtual cuboid point -> may provide association/context evidence, not authority to move q or replace the reference.
Zero finite input conflicts -> does NOT prove global reference identifiability; absent physical surface -> does NOT prove crop-support learning impossible.

revised_reading_of_prior_future_requirem.canonical_label_definition: Read eight physical/native meanings as eight reference/cuboid semantic meanings, with ordering/orientation/symmetry and instance ownership. No exact physical-surface admission test is added.
revised_reading_of_prior_future_requirem.initializer_native_index: An available output-slot token can condition reference semantics if its cuboid order is verified; it is not a GT coordinate or surface certificate.
revised_reading_of_prior_future_requirem.instance_conditioning: Identifies which target pallet/cuboid an input proposal refers to, especially under stacked instances. It does not require a complete physical mesh.
revised_reading_of_prior_future_requirem.crop_support_execution: If an explicitly declared pixel/crop-support target has valid source labels, lack of generic physical-cue/native8 mapping is not itself a reason to block that experiment. Preserve the task name and do not call a support score a proved semantic cause.
revised_reading_of_prior_future_requirem.amodal_auxiliary: A reference-location auxiliary may supervise the unchanged virtual cuboid projection or a separately named physical cue. Its target meaning must be stated; visibility-class evidence and location uncertainty remain separate.

V73_intake_scope: Continue source RGB/instance/reference feasibility and support-label preparation without reinstating the old surface-support block. Any later fit must state whether it learns crop support, cuboid semantic visibility, generic cue auxiliary, or separately named heads; preserve their different supervision/evaluation denominators.
current_evaluation_scope: Current semantic human labels are evaluation-only semantic/crop-transfer evidence, not pixel masks. No current case, labels or model scores were read for this clarification.
